name: Shieldmaidens
headerMeta: Golden era · Melee shield infantry · blob/anti-ranged anchor · 280 leadership · Seasonal
pitch: A hyper-micro shield anchor that buffs the blob and shreds diving heroes when run at full capacity — the weapon-swap loop between cover-commander stances is the entire unit. Lose that rhythm and high-burst units or spacing punish it hard.

doctrines.name: CCi Doctrine (Stand Fast)
doctrines.note: one more button but too strong to skip

doctrines.name: Block Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +300 block, -90 flat DMG taken (applied after all other reductions).

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Consistent across scenarios; the main line for shieldmaiden players.

battleRole.positioning: Plant via spell 1 (circle placement, +250 defence buff once settled), then spell 2 cover-commander and swap to sword mode — lock inputs and hold. {1} Reset cover-commander before engages when possible; its hidden passive damage-reduction decays 60% → 30% over 5s. {1} Despite being a shield unit it carries a notably deeper HP/armor pool than lighter shield infantry, letting it anchor a line under sustained CC where those units collapse. {2}
battleRole.tips: Weapon-swap (spell 3) is the core loop and carries CC-immunity, resetting stance and removing existing CC on every swap. {1} Spear→sword after any hit: +500 Piercing/Slashing Armour Penetration per soldier for 10s. {1} Sword→spear: restores 2% max health/s per soldier for 10s. {1} Stack swaps indefinitely off one random hit during downtime. {1} Sword-mode shield-bash (spell 2) ends in a weaker cover-commander than spear-mode — don't get baited into it. {1} When you have time: sword charge (spell 1, void-cast +20% atk buff to allies) → swap to spear → formation (spell 1) → cover-commander (spell 2) → swap to sword and freeze. {1} When you DON'T have time: start spear → formation (spell 1) → cover-commander (spell 2) → swap to sword and freeze. {1}

controls.notes: Formation (spell 1) places the unit at circle centre and applies +250 def once settled. {1} Cover-commander (spell 2, spear-mode) applies a hidden 60%→30%-over-5s damage-reduction passive — reset before fights. {1} Weapon-swap (spell 3) carries CC-immunity, resets stance, removes existing CC, and triggers the stance-swap buff for 10s: spear→sword = +500 AP per soldier; sword→spear = 2% max HP regen/s per soldier. {1} Stack the swaps indefinitely off one random hit during downtime. {1} Sword-mode shield-bash (spell 2) ends in a weaker cover-commander — avoid unless CC-immunity is needed. {1} X-move or shield-bash while in sword-mode cover-commander cancels it; the CC-immunity doctrine is still safe to use. {1}
